name: Archer
look: A cartoon still of Sterling Archer from the animated series Archer: a square-jawed man with slicked-back black hair, blue eyes and a cleft chin, in a gray suit and dark tie, looking at the viewer with a smug, self-assured expression in a mid-century office.
use: Smug warnings and one-liners from the arrogant spy. The best-known version asks do you want something, then answers because that's how you get it, pointing out an obvious consequence.
slots: the setup, often do you want ___? (top)
the punchline, often because that's how you get ___ (bottom)
examples: Because hitting reply all is how you get a 47-email thread
Because leaving pizza crusts under the couch is how you get ants
describe: cartoon spy in a gray suit looking smug
cartoon spy with a cleft chin staring confidently
animated secret agent with slicked back black hair
smug spy cartoon asking do you want ants
square jawed cartoon guy in a suit and tie
origin: Sterling Archer, the spy voiced by H. Jon Benjamin in the FX animated series Archer.
